text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On a certain day off, I spotted Symboli 
Rudolf in town.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
This shop is... No, that probably wouldn't 
match their taste.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She seemed to be shopping, but... behind 
her, I caught sight of some familiar 
figures.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
W-Wait up, pleaseee~~... I-I'm... feeling 
dizzyyy~~...!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh!? Geez, climb onto my back! We're 
gonna lose sight of Kaicho!

text_block_list.name: Stylish Shop Clerk
text_block_list.text:
—Then, how about a fountain pen? You can 
choose from designs crafted in various 
countries.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Italian-made ones are indeed 
gorgeous. However, I shall go with—this 
German-made piece.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
An elegant yet functional form passed down 
unbroken since the company's founding. 
Truly, it is precisely what I was looking 
for.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Furthermore, since I wish to gift this 
with deep affection, would you mind 
including a personalized message?

text_block_list.name: Teio & Tsurumaru
text_block_list.text: D-Deep... affection...!?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Pardon me, but could you please change the 
reserved course to the one with this 
antipasto?

text_block_list.name: Restaurant Staff
text_block_list.text:
Understood. Your table has been prepared 
in the private room over there.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
It seems the two of us will be able to 
enjoy a quiet evening tonight.

text_block_list.name: Teio & Tsurumaru
text_block_list.text:
In a private room... just the two of 
them...!?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
—Yes, I have arrived at the meeting spot. 
Fufu... I am eager to see you as well.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Picking out a present, reserving a private 
room at a restaurant... And then that 
phone call! T-This means—

text_block_list.name: Teio & Tsurumaru
text_block_list.text: She's going on a date with someone...!!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Now, now. What on earth are you two on 
about?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
K-Kaicho!? Don't tell me you noticed us 
the whole time...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Well, when you make such a massive racket, 
I would notice even from a distance.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: B-But...!!

text_block_list.name: Teio & Tsurumaru
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh, a change of plans!? What, a change 
of plans!?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
My apologies. There is no falsehood in my 
desire to train together with both of you.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
However, an urgent and unavoidable matter 
suddenly came up...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...Forgive me! I will surely make it up to 
you someday. I will reach out to you, so 
please wait for my message—

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
For the President to prioritize someone 
over training—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Just who could that person be...?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
...After hearing all that, of course we're 
gonna be curious~!? Who are you 
meeting~~!!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...Hmm, let's see. A person so 
indispensable and deeply precious that my 
life cannot be told without them—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
...S-Someone that close...? Could it be... 
It couldn't be, but still...!!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: In short, it is my grandfather.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
He usually resides in France, but he is 
temporarily returning to Japan. I have 
been running all over town preparing a 
proper welcome.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Wah, the President's grandfather... He 
must be such a wonderful person~...!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Yes, precisely! Perhaps because he has 
traveled to many countries, every single 
gesture of his is refined.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Ever since I was a child up until now, I 
have held nothing but deep admiration for 
him.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
That is why, in welcoming him, I wished to 
extend the hospitality he deserves. Hence 
why I was bustling about.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: The person the President admires, huh...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
...Somehow, I feel like I totally 
understand how you feel right now, 
President! So—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... We're gonna head back now! We 
can't get in the way of such a rare 
opportunity♪

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Feel free to introduce us by saying 
you have such thoughtful juniors, okay?♪

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Thank you both. I shall enjoy myself 
today.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to repeatedly bumping into the 
three of them, I was able to witness a 
heartwarming scene.
